info.title: Fuuga.Server
info.description: This package contains OpenAI and Anthropic compatible HTTP server for Fuuga, to be used from tools like OpenCode.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: fuuga-serve — OpenAI-compatible HTTP server for Fuuga

options.name: --name
options.description: Server name reported to the master (default: fuuga-minion)

options.name: --role
options.description:
Specialty woven into the delegate tool description,
e.g. 'F# coding errands' — lets the master route by capability

options.name: --checkpoint
options.description: A Fuuga-trained model (in-process); pair with --tokenizer

options.name: --tokenizer
options.description: Tokenizer directory for --checkpoint

options.name: --gguf
options.description: In-process GGUF model via LLamaSharp (fully local)

options.name: --chat-format
options.description: Prompt template for --gguf: chatml | llama3 | raw (default: chatml)

options.name: --endpoint
options.description: OpenAI-compatible server, e.g. local Ollama/llama.cpp

options.name: --model
options.description: Model name for --endpoint (default: local)

options.name: --api-key
options.description: Optional bearer token for --endpoint

options.name: --root
options.description: Workspace root the minion is confined to (default: cwd)

options.name: --allow-write
options.description: Permit write_file, replace_in_file, apply_edits and lsp_rename

options.name: --allow-run
options.description: Permit the run_command tool (default: off)

options.name: --web
options.description: Enable built-in web tools (web_fetch, wikipedia/github/nuget/npm)

options.name: --mcp-config
options.description: Connect to MCP servers from this config and expose their tools

options.name: --lsp-config
options.description: Start language servers from this config and expose lsp_diagnostics/

options.name: --skills
options.description: Load Anthropic-style SKILL.md skills from <dir> (repeatable;

options.name: --confidence
options.description: Escalate below this confidence (0..1, default: 0.6)

options.name: --no-self-verify
options.description: Skip the self-grading pass (faster, weaker signal)

options.name: --verify-command
options.description: Run this in the workspace root after an errand that changed files

options.name: --max-steps
options.description: Default tool-call rounds per errand (default: 8; max 64)

options.name: --checkpoint
options.description: Checkpoint directory (step-N folder)

options.name: --tokenizer
options.description: Tokenizer directory

options.name: --package
options.description: Load from a .fuuga package (replaces --checkpoint + --tokenizer)

options.name: --host
options.description: Listen address (default: 127.0.0.1)

options.name: --port
options.description: Listen port (default: 8080)

options.name: --api-key
options.description: Require Bearer token / x-api-key for /v1/* routes

options.name: --model-name
options.description: Override model name (default: derived from checkpoint dir)

options.name: --mcp-config
options.description: MCP server config file (default: none)

options.name: --api-compat
--chat-template
options.description:
Prompt format: fuuga|llama3|phi3|phi4|gemma3|gemma4|chatml|qwen|mistral
(default: read from the tokenizer's turn markers, else fuuga).
The wrong template degrades output and suppresses tool calling.
For a donor with no name above (deepseek,
glm, kimi-k3), pass its template verbatim; any value containing
{role} is used as-is, e.g. --chat-template "<|user|>{role}: {content}"

options.name: --observe
options.description: Enable request tracing

options.name: --offload
options.description: Offload layers to CPU (reduces VRAM usage)

options.name: --gpu-layers
options.description: Keep first N layers on GPU (rest offloaded)

options.name: --mmap
options.description: Use memory-mapped loading from model.safetensors (faster startup)

options.name: --eager
options.description: Load all weights resident instead of letting available memory choose placement

options.name: --stream
options.description: Page weights from the checkpoint per layer (least memory, much slower decode)

options.name: --rag
options.description: Retrieve context per request from a vector index (build with 'fuuga rag index')

options.name: --rag-top-k
options.description: Chunks to retrieve per request (default: 4)

options.name: --rag-threshold
options.description: Minimum cosine similarity to include a chunk (default: 0.0)

options.name: --rag-hybrid
options.description: Fuse dense and BM25 keyword rankings (reciprocal rank fusion)

options.name: --rag-rerank
options.description:
Rerank the retrieved candidates before the top-k go into the prompt:
mmr (diversity), cross (a cross-encoder judge; needs --reranker) or
judge (a typed relevance question to --decision-model, else the served model)

options.name: --reranker
options.description: Cross-encoder for --rag-rerank cross (from 'fuuga import-reranker')

options.name: --embedder
options.description:
Query embedder: where the one the --rag index records is now, or the
semantic cache's without --rag (default: the index's, else the model)

options.name: --embedder-cpu
options.description: Run the query embedder on the CPU (gte-modernbert-base: 231 ms vs 29 ms per query)

options.name: --reranker-cpu
options.description:
Run --reranker on the CPU (12 paragraphs: 2.4 s vs 0.45 s per request)
--decision-model-cpu Run --decision-model on the CPU (Laya: 0.49 s vs 0.09 s per question)
Each leaves the GPU to the generative model; measured on a 6 GB laptop GPU.

options.name: --rag-graph
options.description: Fuse knowledge-graph facts into the context (build with 'fuuga graph add|extract'); works with or without --rag

options.name: --decision-model
--decide-calibration
options.description: Temperature table from 'fuuga decide calibrate' for POST /v1/decide

options.name: --decide-graph
options.description: Knowledge graph: POST /v1/decide appends to each state the facts about the entities it names

options.name: --decide-graph-facts
options.description: Facts per state at most (default: the decision model's recorded cap, else 8)

options.name: --strict-window
options.description:
Refuse a decision whose state does not fit the decision model's input (400 on
/v1/decide, 422 on /v1/systemone) instead of deciding on its start

options.name: --guardrails
options.description: Enable input/output guardrails (prompt-injection, PII, content)

options.name: --continuous-batching
options.description:
Serve concurrent requests through the continuous-batching engine
(shared paged KV cache, requests interleave) instead of one-at-a-time.
EXPERIMENTAL. Note: --verify and tool-calling are not applied in this
mode; response_format json_schema and forced tool_choice (required/named)
are rejected with 400 — use the default single-inference mode for those.

options.name: --cb-cache-gb
options.description:
KV-cache pool budget in GiB for --continuous-batching (default: auto —
from free VRAM on CUDA, system RAM on CPU). Also: FUUGA_CB_CACHE_GB.

options.name: --provider-config
options.description:
Host as an OpenRouter provider: JSON file with per-model pricing,
API keys + initial credit balances, and an admin token. Enables the
prepaid credit ledger (per-key debit, 402 when exhausted), enriched
/v1/models pricing, and /admin/credits/* top-up endpoints.

options.name: --drift-state
options.description:
Monitor output drift: every completed generation's confidence
signals feed a reference-vs-current statistical test. The reference
window, retraining triggers and the decision log live in <dir>;
inspect with GET /v1/drift (/admin/drift under --provider-config), decide
with 'fuuga drift' (nothing is retrained automatically).

options.name: --drift-interval
options.description: Seconds between drift analysis runs (default: 300).

options.name: --drift-test
options.description:
Test of the output-drift monitor: ks (default; two-sample
Kolmogorov-Smirnov, critical at p < alpha/10) or psi (equal-width
PSI, critical at 0.2).

options.name: --memory
options.description:
Persistent session memory (default: off). Completed chat turns are
remembered per session (X-Fuuga-Session header, 'default' when absent)
and relevant ones recalled into later prompts, across conversations and
restarts. Per request, X-Fuuga-Memory: read | off. Manage it with
GET/POST/DELETE /v1/memory.

options.name: --memory-top-k
options.description: Past exchanges recalled per request (default: 4; pinned notes always)

options.name: --memory-max-entries
options.description: Entries kept per session; oldest exchanges evicted first (default: 1000)

options.name: --semantic-cache
options.description:
Reuse answers (default: off): a chat request asking what an earlier
one asked, with the same system prompt and earlier turns, gets the earlier
answer without a generation. Candidates by embedding, confirmed by a
judge (--decision-model, else the served model). Plain answers only (no
tools, response_format, verify, thinking). Per request, X-Fuuga-Cache:
refresh | off; DELETE /v1/cache forgets the caller's answers.

options.name: --cache-threshold
options.description: Cosine similarity a cached question needs to be judged (default: 0.85)

options.name: --cache-judge-threshold
options.description: P(same question) the judge must give (default: 0.9)

options.name: --cache-no-judge
options.description: Serve the most similar candidate on the embedding alone

options.name: --cache-max-entries
options.description: Cached answers kept; oldest go first (default: 10000)

options.name: --cache-ttl
options.description: Do not serve answers older than this (default: no expiry)

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help message
